resources.string: Questions & answers
Backup & restore
Save your library to a file or bring it back
Why isn’t K4 Audio on the Play Store?

K4 Audio plays songs from YouTube Music and JioSaavn. The Play Store doesn’t allow apps that stream from these services without an official licence, so K4 Audio is shared as a free APK from kartiklangwan.vercel.app instead. It has no ads, no account and no tracking.
How do I update to a new version?

Download the latest APK from the website and install it over the current app. Your favourites, playlists and history stay as they are.\n\nIf Android says “App not installed” or that the package conflicts: first make a backup (Settings → Backup & restore → Backup), then uninstall K4 Audio, install the new APK and restore your backup.
How do I back up or move my library?

Open Settings → Backup & restore.

• Backup saves one .db file with your favourites, playlists, history and lyrics. Keep it in Downloads or on Google Drive.
• Restore picks that file. K4 Audio checks it, keeps a copy of your current library, swaps it in and restarts.

Use it before uninstalling, when changing phones, or before trying a different build.
Where do I put my own songs, and how do I bring music from my PC?

Put audio files in Music → K4 Audio on your phone. They appear under Library → Local by themselves, and the Open music folder button there takes you to the folder.
From a PC: connect the phone with USB, choose File transfer, then copy the audio files into Music → K4 Audio. On the PC app the same folder is Music\K4 Audio, and Scan adds new files.
Likes and playlists travel separately: PC Settings → Phone transfer shows a QR code, and the phone sends them from Settings → Backup & restore → Send library to PC.
Are my downloaded songs in the backup?
No. The backup holds your library, not the audio files. After restoring on a new phone, open a playlist and tap the download icon to fetch its songs again.
How do I download songs for offline listening?

Hold any song and choose Download, or tap the download icon on a playlist or album to save all of it. Everything you saved is in Library → Downloads, where you can also see progress, cancel, retry or delete all.
Can I bring my Spotify or YouTube Music playlists?

Yes. Go to Library → Playlists → Import and paste the playlist link. Spotify only shares the first 100 tracks of a playlist without a login; songs that can’t be matched are listed so you can retry them.
How do I save mobile data or get the best sound?
Settings → Player → Streaming quality: Data saver, Balanced or High quality. The equalizer, bass boost and other effects are under Settings → Audio effects.
A song won’t play. What can I do?

Check your internet first. Some songs are removed or blocked in your region; search for the song again and pick another version (results from JioSaavn are included). Turning on Settings → Player → Skip on error moves on automatically.
Found a bug or have an idea?
Message @K4RTIK.nvm on Instagram, or visit kartiklangwan.vercel.app. Settings → Other → Logs has details you can share.
